metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels over Hong Kong increase between February 10-25, 2020 and April 20-May 12, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 data (COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2) - Two time periods: Feb 10-25, 2020 and Apr 20-May 12, 2020 - Location: Hong Kong (approximately 22.3°N, 114.2°E) 2. Masking strategy: - Use quality flag (qa_value) to filter out poor quality pixels - Sentinel-5P typically uses qa_value >= 0.75 for good quality data - This is about NO2 levels, not clouds, so we mask based on data quality 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - NO2 values should be in mol/m² (typically 0-0.001 range) - Zero or near-zero is valid (could indicate low pollution) - Null/NaN indicates calculation failure (C3) - If no pixels after masking, that's C2 - If no images in collection, that's C1 - Compare means: if April-May > Feb, answer A; otherwise B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const hongKong = ee.Geometry.Point([114.1694, 22.3193]); const buffer = hongKong.buffer(30000); // 30km buffer around Hong Kong const period1Start = '2020-02-10'; const period1End = '2020-02-26'; const period2Start = '2020-04-20'; const period2End = '2020-05-13'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const no2Collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); const col1 = no2Collection .filterDate(period1Start, period1End) .filterBounds(buffer); const col2 = no2Collection .filterDate(period2Start, period2End) .filterBounds(buffer); const size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Period 1 (Feb 10-25): ${size1} images`); console.log(`Period 2 (Apr 20-May 12): ${size2} images`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("No data available for one or both periods."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing with quality masking function maskPoorQuality(image) { const qa = image.select('qa_value'); const mask = qa.gte(0.75); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Apply quality mask and create mean composites const no2_1 = col1.map(maskPoorQuality).mean(); const no2_2 = col2.map(maskPoorQuality).mean(); // 4. Calculate mean NO2 and pixel counts const stats1 = await no2_1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: buffer, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = await no2_2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: buffer, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mean1 = stats1.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean; const count1 = stats1.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count; const mean2 = stats2.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean; const count2 = stats2.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count; console.log(`Period 1: Mean NO2 = ${mean1}, Valid pixels = ${count1}`); console.log(`Period 2: Mean NO2 = ${mean2}, Valid pixels = ${count2}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after quality masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (mean1 === null || mean1 === undefined || mean2 === null || mean2 === undefined || isNaN(mean1) || isNaN(mean2)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid results."); console.log("C3"); return; } const percentChange = ((mean2 - mean1) / mean1 * 100).toFixed(2); console.log(`Change: ${percentChange}%`); if (mean2 > mean1) { console.log("NO2 levels increased from Feb to Apr-May period."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("NO2 levels did not increase."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
